projects.title: Sistema de Investigación e Información Policial
projects.description: Large scale enterprise Web application, developed with Java technologies: JSF, Spring, Hibernate, Acegi Security System, Rich Faces. I worked as a developer in the Criminology module. I often had to face use cases that were critical to the system architecture, and so I had to design many mechanisms and structures that were used throughout the system and incorporated in the architecture. Examples of these were: the image handling mechanism (image uploading components, image format conversion and storage, database image retrieval and displaying components), the legal base mechanism, the servlet communication mechanism and the JSF backing bean architecture that was used on the entire module. I was often consulted by the architects about new decisions. I pioneered vertical development, programming use cases from the database to presentation, which was later generalized to all the other developers. Among my greatest achievements was the reduction of the compilation and local deployment time from 5 minutes to 30 seconds, which represented a huge boost in productivity for the entire project team.
